environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL attached (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/migration-api-acl/a1b2c3d4). The Web ACL includes a rule group reference statement pointing to a CUSTOM rule group (not AWS managed) named 'expr-injection-body-rules' with priority 1. This rule group contains a single rule using a RegexPatternSet that inspects the JSON body (JsonBody with IncludedPaths: ['/params/expression']) for patterns matching common Python eval exploitation vectors. The RegexPatternSet (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/regexpatternset/py-eval-patterns/x1y2z3) contains patterns: '__import__', 'os\.', 'subprocess', 'exec\(', 'compile\(', 'getattr', '__class__', '__subclasses__', 'open\(', 'system\('. The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, the Web ACL has a second rule (priority 2) with a SizeConstraint on the Body field limiting request bodies to 2048 bytes. The ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alerting on 403 responses from WAF.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL attached
config.waf_rule_1: Custom rule group 'expr-injection-body-rules' priority 1, inspects JsonBody at /params/expression with RegexPatternSet containing: __import__|os\.|subprocess|exec\(|compile\(|getattr|__class__|__subclasses__|open\(|system\(
config.waf_rule_2: SizeConstraint on Body, max 2048 bytes, action BLOCK
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet with restricted SG
config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on WAF BLOCK actions
